notes: A STALLED READ IS TRIED AGAIN AT ONCE, A STALLED DOWNLOAD RESUMES. A packet dropped after the connection is up climbs a retransmit ladder that a 300-second read timeout let run for twenty seconds in silence. Searches, size checks and downloads now wait at most 10 seconds between bytes; a stalled search is asked again at once, a stalled download resumes from the byte it reached, and the log says so once. Since 1.3.79: a dropped connection attempt costs 3 seconds instead of 21.
